brief:
Repaired car batteries in Gaza pose a serious health threat to children, Shehab Wire reported. The batteries, restored through informal processes, leak lead contamination that harms child development and health outcomes across the territory.

The article documents scientific evidence linking lead exposure to stunted growth and cognitive damage in children. It calls for urgent action to address the unregulated battery repair industry and protect vulnerable populations from ongoing poisoning risks.
dek: Repaired car batteries in Gaza pose a serious health threat to children, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Lead poisoning from repaired batteries threatens Gaza's children
